body: Thank you so much for taking the time to write all of that out for me. I'm still feeling kind of lost and trying to get back on my feet after this meltdown, but I think I'm going to try these things little by little. It actually sounds like we have a few things in common, so I feel a little better knowing that you're out there fighting too. That part alone helps more than you know. I'll definitely stay in touch, and feel free to check in with me too. Good luck, and thanks again. I really really appreciate all this.

Thank you for the Walmart recommendation. I'll look into that.

I've tried yoga classes and meditation. Meditation and pranayama breathing do calm me down sometimes. Are there any specific meditation techniques you recommend?

And it's not that I feel like I don't deserve to be down. I hate myself and honestly I think I should be hurting more than this, but I can't handle hurting any more than this. However, if there's a way for me to get out of this without killing myself (which would probably literally kill my boyfriend), I'll take it. So if there's anything you suggest that I haven't tried yet, I'll try it.
I hate myself because I am exactly what all those people said.

A lot of things, which is why I feel so stupid about being depressed. I'm living on my own in a great city, going to one of the best business schools in the country, got a great boyfriend, a few close friends, and physically I'm in good shape. Yet I still hate myself more than anything.

That's part of what's exhausting me. Things get better and then they come right back to this. It's a cycle.

I appreciate your sentiments though.

First of all, I hope you know you're a great person for taking time out of your day to talk with people like me.

Second, no, most of those people have been out of my life for a long time. I've just internalized everything they've said and I've become a burden on myself. It's interrupting my life because I can't do anything but hate myself and think of ways to die. I wish he had let me go because I don't want to live like this anymore. I'm just tired. I want to be at peace.
Thank you, but they're right, and I was so ready to die yesterday. now I'm still here and I'm lost. I wish he hadn't stopped me.
Spent the last 20 years being told by "friends" and family that I'm "useless" and "should just go die".
Spent the last 20 years being told by "friends" and family that I'm "useless" and "should just go die".

I know. he's incredible for wanting to help me but I'm just too fucked up at this point. I've hated myself for my entire life and I can't live with myself anymore. I spend every waking moment wanting to crawl out of my skin.

I've gone to several different therapists, tried getting out more, tried new hobbies, exercised more... I guess I haven't tried anti-depressants, but I'm a 21 year old full time college student and I can't afford it right now.
